candidates.question: Prove by induction that $1 + 4 + 7 + \dots + (3n - 2) = \frac{n(3n-1)}{2}$ for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$.

lines.text: LHS = RHS, so the formula is true for $n = 1$.

steps.title: Assume it is true for $n = k$
Add the next term for $n = k + 1$
Compare with the formula at $n = k + 1$

lines.text: This matches, so true for $n=k$ implies true for $n=k+1$. By induction the formula holds for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$.

candidates.question:
The sum of the first $n$ square numbers is $T_n = \frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$.
The next term is $T_{n+1} = T_n + (n+1)^2$.
Substitute the formula for $T_n$ and show that $T_{n+1} = \frac{(n+1)(n+2)(2n+3)}{6}$.
